indicator_metadata.description: Gross domestic product is the most commonly used single measure of a country's overall economic activity. It represents the total value at current prices of final goods and services produced within a country during a specified time period, such as one year.
indicator_metadata.label: GDP, current prices

license: IMF terms for use of statistical data; separate from SENSE MIT license
note: Historical WEO estimates; not necessarily directly measured observations. Years after 2024 and regional totals excluded. SENSE converts billions to dollars and derives weights; these transformations are not IMF products.
